name: jyu_idle
desc: Pixel art game sprite of a huge, heavy bear man made entirely of glossy brown paint. His head and face are exactly the face reference: a squarish head with small round ears and short brown hair, a short boxy muzzle, a small black nose sitting directly on a flat, unbroken muzzle, the only line on the lower muzzle being the short horizontal mouth line, small eyes that are solid dark glossy beads of paint under thick angular black eyebrows, a grumpy stern look, the mouth closed. The whole face is slick, wet and glistening like fresh paint, with bright wet highlights on the brow, muzzle and cheeks, paint oozing down the face. His body, legs, feet and paint pattern are exactly the front and side view references: very broad shoulders, thick arms, a big round belly, thick straight legs with bare human feet, brown paint with random messy cream splotches that also fall across the face, paint dripping from the chin and hands. His whole body is turned three-quarters to the left like the side view reference, chest and belly facing the lower left, the far shoulder and arm partly hidden behind the body, standing idle pose with arms hanging at his sides. Clean pixel art game sprite style: dark outline, glossy highlights, drips. Plain flat light gray background, the character alone.
